review_description: Unlike many companies that quoted this company came to the site before quoting whereas others quoted using Google Earth photos. I understand these other companies would not go ahead before doing a site check but I thought that seeing the site before even quoting certainly saved my time (and possibly theirs) by being sure the site was suitable for what I wanted. Being a local firm they could do this more easily. They also checked that I understood the process of energy generation on my roof, correcting at least one misconception I had even though I'd done quite a lot of research.
System to be installed on 21 June. You can contact me then for follow up if you wish.

I am very thankful to Solar Quotes as I was scouring the net for information and found it hard to find. Your company gave me loads of information which was easy to understand and I  became an expert! It was very thorough and gave me lots of questions to ask companies when I rang them so I was  then able to compare them.
I recommend the Green Solar Group strongly, for rhe above rating.
some of the dealers I spoke to had very poor knowledge of what they were selling.

I sought to check on the brands through the internet and was not able to get information on the Solar panels and only limited information on the inverter to be used by Nicholls Solar.  We were very interested in their quote as it was quite a bit cheaper than the one we went with, but the product was the issue.  When requesting the same brands offered by Green Solar the quotes were more oor less the same.  Green Solar were also able to install and get the system operational in a better timeframe.
